name: Measured Quote
author: besrestphotos

sections.description:
Most quote forms send you “hello, how much for my hedge?”. You call back, ask for the length, calculate, and send a price.

Measured Quote asks for the measurements and shows the estimate while the visitor fills in the form. You receive a complete request: services, quantities, estimated amount and contact details.

Built for trades that charge by measurement: hedge trimming, lawn mowing, fencing, painting, flooring, tiling, roof cleaning, curtains, signs, earthworks.

Free version

  • Catalog of services priced per linear meter, per square meter or as a flat rate.
  • Instant estimate for the visitor, excluding tax and, if you wish, including VAT.
  • Price recalculated by your server on every submission: a visitor cannot change it from the browser.
  • Requests stored in your WordPress admin with every line detailed, plus an email notification you can reply to directly.
  • Bot protection without a “I am not a robot” checkbox.
  • 40 currencies (euro, dollar, pound, Swiss franc, yen, CFA franc…) and metric or imperial units (ft, ft², ft³), set automatically from the site language and adjustable in the settings.
  • Amounts calculated to the cent, with the same rounding in the browser and on the server.

Pro version

  • Services with several dimensions (length × height, length × width × depth), cubic meters and cubic yards.
  • Tiered pricing, by band or on the whole quantity.
  • Options: single choices, checkboxes, quantities, fixed fees and percentages, with conditions between options.
  • Export of all requests to CSV, readable in Excel, with the currency of each request.

Languages

The interface is available in 27 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Thai. It follows your site language; a regional variant uses the closest language, and any other language falls back to English. Translations other than French are machine translations and welcome review.

Privacy

  • Quote requests are stored only in your WordPress site. This plugin does not send them to Freemius or any other service.
  • Licensing and updates of the Pro version are handled by Freemius. Usage data is only shared if you opt in. Freemius terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/ and privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
  • The plugin prepares an estimate: it does not issue signed quotes or invoices.

Français

Formulaire de demande de devis chiffré au mètre linéaire, au m² ou au forfait : le visiteur voit son estimation immédiatement, vous recevez une demande déjà calculée. Calcul refait par votre serveur, demandes enregistrées dans WordPress et notifiées par courriel, 40 monnaies, unités métriques ou impériales. La version Pro ajoute les dimensions multiples, le m³, les prix dégressifs, les options avec conditions et l’export CSV.

Deutsch

Angebotsanfragen nach Meter, Quadratmeter oder Pauschale: Besucher sehen ihre Schätzung sofort, Sie erhalten eine bereits berechnete Anfrage. Die Pro-Version bietet mehrere Maße, Staffelpreise, Optionen mit Bedingungen und CSV-Export.

Español

Solicitudes de presupuesto por metro lineal, metro cuadrado o precio fijo: el visitante ve su estimación al instante y usted recibe una solicitud ya calculada. La versión Pro añade varias dimensiones, precios por tramos, opciones con condiciones y exportación CSV.

Italiano

Richieste di preventivo al metro lineare, al metro quadro o a forfait: il visitatore vede subito la stima e voi ricevete una richiesta già calcolata. La versione Pro aggiunge più dimensioni, prezzi a scaglioni, opzioni con condizioni ed esportazione CSV.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Measured Quote”, then install and activate it. An example catalog is created.
  2. Open Measured Quote > Settings and replace the example with your own services and prices. Check the currency, units and VAT.
  3. Add the shortcode [measured_quote] to the page of your choice.
  4. Pro version: after purchase, enter your license key in the activation screen. Do not share your license key.
sections.faq:
Is the estimate binding for my business?

A note, editable in the settings, states that the estimate is not a quote. Word it according to your situation.

Who sets the prices?

You do. Each service has your own price per meter, per square meter or flat rate. Visitors only enter their measurements.

Are requests deleted if I uninstall the plugin?

No. The catalog and settings can be removed, but received requests are kept: they are your customers’ data.

Can I change the look?

The form inherits your theme’s styles. All classes start with dm-.

What happens when the Pro license expires?

The form and existing requests keep working. Updates and support require an active license.
sections.changelog:
0.3.11

  • Removed suppress_filters from the migration query.
  • Prefixed all template variables in the public form view.

0.3.10

  • Security: service HTML added by the Pro version is now filtered through wp_kses() before output.
  • Readme: link to the Freemius terms of service added next to its privacy policy.

0.3.9

  • All functions, classes, options, hooks and stored data now use the unique “measqu” prefix. Existing settings, catalog and quote requests are migrated automatically.
  • New shortcode [measured_quote]; the former [devis_metrage] keeps working.

0.3.8

  • New editable “Note about measurements” setting: tells visitors that the business may re-measure and reassess the quote if the dimensions are not accurate. Shown under the estimate, in the request details and in the notification email.

0.3.7

  • Text domain renamed to measured-quote to match the WordPress.org slug.

0.3.6

  • WordPress.org readiness: English readme, translator comments, standard direct-access guards, sanitized server variables, no custom update header.

0.3.5

  • Dimensions, quantities and amounts calculated to two decimals, with the same rounding in the browser and on the server.
  • Existing installations keep euros and metric units after updating, whatever the site language.
  • Each request keeps the currency and units in force when it was received; the CSV export shows the currency of each request.

0.3.4

  • 22 new languages (27 in total); English fallback for untranslated languages.
  • Currency setting (40 currencies, automatic from the site language) and imperial units (linear foot, ft², ft³).
  • Pro: cubic yards calculated from dimensions in feet.
  • Indian digit grouping (1,00,000) on Indian English and Hindi sites.
  • VAT amount shown in the form, the email and the request details; total including VAT in the request list.

0.3.3

  • Multilingual description.

0.3.2

  • Pro: services screen with options, tiers and conditions; public form with options; instant estimate identical to the server.

0.3.1

  • Instant estimate also works when block themes render the form before the header; larger touch targets; visible keyboard focus.

0.3.0

  • Product name Measured Quote; Freemius SDK 2.13.5 for licenses and updates.

0.2.0

  • Requests restricted to administrators; notification status and manual resend; rate limiting; translated errors and units.

0.1.0

  • First release: catalog per linear meter, square meter and flat rate, instant estimate, stored requests, email notification.
